name: Pricing
description: Price plans side by side: name, price, period, a short description, a feature list and a button each. The featured plan is raised and badged.

columns.description: Plans per row on wide screens; one on phones, two on tablets.

layout.description: cards: plans side by side. table: one comparison table, plans as columns and features as rows (for more than four plans).

featureStyle.description: The mark before each feature in the cards: a check, a dot, or the list's own bullets.

billingToggle.description: radio: two labelled radios swap each plan's price for its priceAlt (monthly / yearly), with no script. The radio group is named from the section id, or a hash of the plans without one, so two toggles on a page stay independent.

intro.label: Intro
intro.description: A line or two under the heading.

plans.label: Plans

price.label: Price
price.description: The price as shown, with its currency ("$12", "Free", "On request").

description.label: Description
description.description: One line on who the plan is for.

features.label: Features
features.description: What the plan includes, as a markdown list.

featured.label: Featured
featured.description: Raises the plan and gives it the badge.

badge.label: Badge
badge.description: A badge text on the plan ("Best value"); a featured plan without one reads the section's featuredLabel.

priceAlt.label: Price, other period
priceAlt.description: The price for the other billing period ("€150"), shown when the toggle is on its second option.

periodAlt.label: Period, other period
periodAlt.description: What the other price is per ("/year").

plans.description: The plans, in display order (Divi pricing tables, Elementor price table).

id.description: Anchor id of the section; the heading gets `<id>-title`.

compact.description: A denser card: smaller padding, gap and price.

includedLabel.description: Table cell text for readers where a plan has the feature.

notIncludedLabel.description: Table cell text for readers where a plan lacks the feature.

measured.description: The source section's measured style (MeasuredStyle): frame width, padding, fill, image, columns per width, gap, text tone, radius, minimum height — all in pixels. Absent, the site's tokens; present, it wins over tone and columns. Values that are not a number, a colour or a known keyword are dropped.

color.description: Fill colour: hex, rgb(a) or hsl(a).

image.description: Background image address (http(s) or root-relative), drawn behind the content.

overlay.description: Colour or linear/radial gradient laid over the image or the fill.

size.description: cover, contain or auto; anything else draws as cover.

position.description: One or two of center/top/bottom/left/right or percentages.

columns.description: Item columns at 390 (base), 768 (md) and 1280 (lg) px; a missing width follows the narrower one.

tone.description: What the text is set for: dark = light text on a dark band. Without it, a fill's own lightness decides.

align.description: Where the heading and lead sit; read by a component whose own align is not set.

billingMainLabel.description: First option of the billing toggle.

billingAltLabel.description: Second option of the billing toggle (the plans' priceAlt).

billingLegend.description: Legend of the toggle, read to screen readers.

a11y: Plans are a <ul>; each name is an <h3> under the section's <h2>, or an <h2> when the section has no heading. A featured plan is marked by a text badge and a ring, not colour alone. Buttons are links with their own label. The table layout is a real <table> with a caption, column and row headers, and Included / Not included text in every cell; the billing toggle is a fieldset with a legend and labelled radios.

pattern.summary: repeated plan units: name + price + feature list + button
